name: Status Window
use_when: Use when the world runs on a visible system that announces every change, awards feats and hands out loot.

loot_common: a torch that never quite goes out
a rope that knots itself on command
trail rations that taste of home
a whetstone that sharpens in one pass
loot_rare: a ring that warms near hidden doors
a map scrap of this place, with one secret marked
a token that turns one miss into 7-9, once
loot_epic: a weapon with a name and an opinion
a cloak that makes the wearer forgettable
a skill book: a new label of your choice
a key that opens one door anywhere, once
